title: Not what I was expecting at all, sizes are way off…
text:
Not what I was expecting at all, sizes are way off…. [[VIDEOID:8d122d6f9b610f63f2400e5b5263af4b]] I don’t like to give 1 star reviews, but the description should say that these are NOT standard sizes. The material and brushed stainless steel look and feel good. But, that doesn’t change the fact that these are unusable to me.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
